question: Where should the lifted ritual items be placed after being brought forward?
premises: The items are lifted and brought forward.
They are to be placed before the deity and fire upon the yantra.
inference: After lifting and bringing the items, one should place them before the deity and fire upon the yantra.
uncertainties: devāgne may be read as before the deity and fire; exact compound sense is context-dependent.
plain_english: Having lifted and brought them, one should place them before the deity and fire, upon the yantra.
